verdict.rationale: Manufact ships an official MCP server exposing the platform, organizations, servers, deployments, logs, and observability as MCP tools, explicitly so users can 'manage everything from Cursor, Claude, or any other MCP client' via natural-language interaction, plus a tailored setup flow with a ready-made starter prompt and fix-prompt copy-paste for coding agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that natural-language commands reliably operate the platform (community evidence only touches unrelated OAuth/pricing issues, not NL command usage).
